Five features: analysis queue, account controls, hotspots, Year in Review, public badges (2026-10-23)

  • Captured with Playwright against the build before the change (HEAD be7c3b6, port 5101) and after (https://localhost:5001), on the same Azurite data: a seeded repository plus this repository, analysed through the new queue.
  • F2, the analysis queue, has one visible surface that is not pictured: a repository whose GitHub token was revoked now shows “Sign-in needed” with a sign-in link in the Status column instead of raw git stderr. Reproducing it needs a revoked token, so it is covered by unit tests instead.

Sidebar: new “Year in Review” link (F9)

A new destination between Code Health and Config. It stays highlighted on /year-in-review/{year}.

Repository detail: two new tabs (F5, F10)

Hotspots and Share join the existing tab strip. ?tab=hotspots and ?tab=share deep-link to them.

Hotspots tab (F5)

Treemap: area is code lines at the newest analysed commit, colour is commits in the page's range. The darkest, largest tiles are the files most worth a look. Every tile opens the file on GitHub at that commit. The same ranking follows as a text list for screen readers and phones.

Share tab (F10)

Off by default. Switching it on publishes two badges and a share page, and shows the README markdown with copy buttons. Turning it off evicts the cached card at once.

Public share page and badges, as a visitor sees them (F10)

Server-rendered, no app boot, follows the visitor's light/dark preference. Below: the lines and health badges, and the grey “unavailable” badge a private or unknown id gets.

Year in Review (F9)

Before: the route did not exist. After: one figure per slide, in the viewer's time zone. Arrow keys, dots and buttons move between slides.

Year in Review: closing card

The last slide is a self-contained SVG card. “Download PNG” saved a 2.4 MB image in the browser test, with no library. An optional one-line Claude caption appears under it when an API key is configured.

Year in Review on a phone

390 px wide, no horizontal scroll (checked in the run).

Settings: “Your data” card (F3)

Before: the page ended at the GitHub permissions card. After: JSON/CSV export, and account deletion behind a typed DELETE confirmation.
